visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed rotating hero slideshow. Each slide fills the viewport width with a background photo. An overlaid white content card sits at the bottom-left containing a heading, description, and one CTA link. Dot indicators are centered below the slides; circular prev/next arrows sit at the bottom-right.
contentPattern: One row per slide. Each row has two cells: the first cell is the slide background image, the second cell holds the text content (heading, description paragraph, and a CTA link).
usage: Full-width homepage or landing hero carousel presenting multiple rotating promotional slides, each with its own imagery and call to action.
